# Takedown Request

Please provide the following information:

### 1. Content/Channel Name
(Required)

### 2. URL(s) to Remove
(Required)

### 3. Proof of Ownership or Authorization
Examples:
- Official website link  
- Copyright certificate  
- Signed authorization  

### 4. Reason for Removal
(Required)

### 5. Contact Information
(Required)

The maintainers will review your request and respond promptly.
